routes.name: Route A — Meghalaya Plateau Northern Bypass
routes.summary: Bypasses all critical slide zones via northern NH-27/MDR valley alignment. 0 active closures reported.
routes.sopAdvisory: Recommended: primary corridor for heavy relief logistics and food trucks per SOP-Logistics

routes.name: Route B — Central Hill Arterial (NH-27 Main)
routes.summary: Faster direct route, but passes near Zubza & Jatinga high risk flanks. Single-lane slow passage.
warnings: Warning: Pagla Pahar fissure reported 1h ago
Verification Required: SH-11 connector under review
routes.sopAdvisory: Recommended: escorted convoys only; light 4x4 emergency vehicles permitted with radio check

routes.name: Route C — Direct Mountain Pass Corridor
routes.summary: Shortest linear corridor, but traverses directly through Jatinga Critical Zone (z1). Verified road breach at Km 84.
warnings: CRITICAL: NH-27 Km 84 Verified Blocked (140m road washed away)
routes.sopAdvisory: Warning: Civilian transit prohibited; air-bridge or specialized all-terrain rescue only per SOP-Evac

routes.name: Route A — Western Ridge Ridge Bypass via Ravangla
routes.summary: Circumvents Teesta river canyon surge via stable elevated western ridge.
routes.sopAdvisory: Recommended: all supply trucks directed through Ravangla detour

routes.name: Route B — Dikchu Riverbank Spur
routes.summary: Teesta toe erosion under BRO containment; speed restricted to 20 km/h.
warnings: Caution: Active BRO earthmoving operations at Dikchu bridge
routes.sopAdvisory: Recommended: pilot car escort required for convoys

routes.name: Route C — NH-10 Teesta Canyon Arterial
routes.summary: Direct gorge highway closed due to river scouring and active scree slope failure at Dikchu-Tung.
warnings: CRITICAL: NH-10 Verified Blocked by Teesta surge breach
routes.sopAdvisory: Warning: impassable for ground transport; contact SDRF for rope bridge or heli evacuation
